title: A handoff premise's Checked time changes only when the session re-read that premise since compaction
why: Coordinator, 2026-11-09 14:11 CST: it marked every handoff premise as checked but had re-checked only two, and fixed it by hand. A false Checked time hides a stale premise from the next session.
note: Sighting 1. Fix to find: a guard that compares each changed Checked time in the handoff against the premises the session actually read or checked since compaction, and refuses a stamp with no read behind it.
